name: The Picture Of Delusion
source:
[One day, whether it was on the internet, in a newspaper or on the TV...]
[In any case, you come across an intriguing place.]
[‘The building of terror where people go missing!’]
[It’s a bit of a cliché, isn’t it?]
[If the building hadn’t happened to be near where you live,
it’s so clichéd that you wouldn’t have given it a second thought.]
[If you hadn’t happened to be unemployed,
with nothing to do and no idea how to pass the time, it’s so clichéd that you wouldn’t have gone there.]
[That’s why you didn’t have high expectations.]
[It’s only natural, really, as rumours like this are usually nothing but lies and hot air.]
[But, much to your misfortune, this time that wasn’t the case.]

[Oh dear! You’ve fainted.]

 [Have a lovely time!]

[From [url=https://arrokoth486958.itch.io/the-picture-of-delusion]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
[某一天，无论是在网络上、报纸上，还是在电视节目里……]
[总之，你偶然得知了一个引人好奇的地方。]
[‘有人接连失踪的恐怖大楼！’]
[听起来有点老套，不是吗？]
[倘若那栋大楼不是恰好就在你住处附近，
这种俗套的传闻根本不会让你多看一眼。]
[倘若你不是恰好正处于失业状态，
无所事事、不知该如何打发时间，这种俗套的地方你也绝对不会踏足半步。]
[正因如此，你原本并没有抱太高的期待。]
[这也是人之常情，毕竟诸如此类的流言十有八九不过是谎言与噱头罢了。]
[然而不幸的是，这一次并非空穴来风。]

[哎呀！你晕过去了。]

[祝你度过一段愉快的时光！]

[摘自[url=https://arrokoth486958.itch.io/the-picture-of-delusion]itch.io[/url]]
